title: ITZGOHAI V12 - REVENANT ELITE | MOBILE
features:
🛠️ HIGHLIGHTED FEATURES:
​🎨 Custom UI Engine: Change your menu theme, adjust ESP colors, and toggle FPS caps (30/60/Uncapped) in the new Settings tab.
​📱 True Mobile Support: Drag-and-drop UI, sink-input fixes (no accidental clicking behind the menu), and a clean minimize button.
​💀 Smart Combat: Kill Aura (25 studs), Tool Reach Extender, Local God Mode, and Big Hitboxes.
​🏃 Advanced Movement: Smooth Mobile Fly, Dash bind, Noclip, High Jump, and Moon Gravity.
​👁️ Pro Visuals: Target Object ESP (search for specific items/coins), Player ESP, X-Ray, and Cinematic/Vaporwave lighting presets.
​📍 Waypoints & Farming: Save up to 3 custom locations, use the "WP1 Loop" for auto-farming, and toggle Auto-Click/Anti-AFK.
​🛡️ Client Anti-Kick: Built-in metamethod hook to prevent games from kicking you.
​⚙️ COMPATIBILITY:
Tested and working perfectly on modern mobile executors like Delta, Codex, and Arceus X.
​Enjoy the cleanest universal script on the market. Drop a like if you want to see V12!
